correctness.rationale: A fully specified pivot-and-first-neighbor matching tree defines an acyclic matching on the whole face poset; monotone branch order rules out directed cycles by induction, not by finite sampling. Its exactly reconstructed critical cells have dimensions 0,8,9 with counts 1,182,19. Signed integer gradient-path reduction produces the full 182-by-19 Morse boundary. An explicitly listed 19-row square submatrix has determinant +1 over Z, verified by exact Bareiss elimination; no torsion and 163 surviving degree-eight generators result. Since the Morse CW model has no cells in degrees 1–7, attaching maps in dimension 9 to its 8-sphere wedge are classified by integer degree vectors, and the primitive boundary supports integral cell cancellations, yielding an actual wedge of 163 S8. Independent matching-polynomial transfer computes 7,594,361 faces and reduced Euler characteristic 163.

originality.rationale: The retracted 2021 work claimed a general sphere-wedge family but its March 2025 corrigendum expressly invalidated its homotopy proof and recorded nine-column homology only in degree eight, with no valid exact homotopy classification. The accessible abstract of Chauhan–Sharma–Shukla (arXiv:2609.27366, posted 2026-09-23) proves connectivity/nonvanishing but does not supply the integral nine-column homotopy type. An extended review describes numerical support through nine columns, not an integral acyclic matching or unit-minor proof. The new certificate determines the full homotopy type and all integral invariants. Targeted published-finding corpus and web searches found no equivalent or mathematically dominating valid result. Main residual risk: full newer primary article inaccessible; it could contain more specific prior data.
residual_risks: The full September 2026 23-page article was unavailable; its text might contain the width-nine Betti rank or a stronger construction than shown by accessible summaries. A numerical rank alone does not yield the integral wedge decomposition.
Database search and finite-work partitioning are not novelty proofs; unindexed valid exact-width homotopy computations may exist.
